raw_proposal.rationale: The focal evidence suggests that the approval threshold for discounts has been raised from 10% to 15%, but it does not establish that Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval is required for discounts above 15%. The focal passage mentions that Option 3 (20%) was discussed but not adopted, implying that the 15% threshold is the new standard.

citations.quotation: Raise the Finance approval threshold from 10% to 15%, effective 2025-03-01. Option 3 (20%) was discussed but not adopted — Harriet felt it removed too much oversight.

interpretation.claim_text: Discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval before the deal is closed.
